headline: Can you name the 3 layers of the heart wall?
body:
Epicardium: outermost layer that surrounds and protects the heart
Myocardium: the muscular middle layer
Endocardium: the inner layer

headline: How many sweat glands do you have?
stat_note: eccrine sweat glands in your skin
body: They are packed tightest on your palms and soles, 250 to 500 per square centimeter. Their main job: cooling you down.
